briefdescription.para: Set all reset controls attached to an RPU core.

para.verbatim: Walks the core's reset-handle list and writes each reset node's register field. A zero value clears each field; a nonzero value sets each field. Processing stops if a reset handle has no reset node.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the RPU core whose reset controls are updated.
Zero to clear the reset fields, nonzero to set them.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS after all reset controls are written; XST_FAILURE if Core is NULL or a reset handle contains a NULL reset node.

briefdescription.para: Configure the TCM boot bit for an RPU core.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the RPU core node IDs for the given device.

para.verbatim: Looks up the RPU core by device ID. When TCM boot is requested, it resets and halts the core, releases its reset, and then sets the TCMBOOT field. Otherwise, it clears the TCMBOOT field directly.

parameterdescription.para: Device ID of the RPU core to configure.
Set to 1U to enable TCM boot; any other value disables TCM boot.

simplesect.para: None. If the core lookup or a reset operation fails, the function returns without modifying the TCMBOOT field.

briefdescription.para: Assert all resets for an RPU core and place the core in halt state.

para.verbatim: Retrieves and validates the RPU core, sets every reset field linked through its reset handles, and writes the core's resume configuration to halt execution.

parameterdescription.para: Device ID of the RPU core to reset and halt.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when all reset fields are asserted and the core is halted; XST_INVALID_PARAM when a registered node is not an RPU core; or XST_FAILURE when the core or one of its reset nodes is absent.

briefdescription.para: Release all reset controls attached to an RPU core.

para.verbatim: Retrieves and validates the RPU core, then clears every reset field linked through its reset handles.

parameterdescription.para: Device ID of the RPU core to release from reset.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when all reset fields are cleared; XST_INVALID_PARAM when a registered node is not an RPU core; or XST_FAILURE when the core or one of its reset nodes is absent.
